messages.text: Hi all — opening a thread here so we've got one place to track the open items ahead of Thursday's review. I'll keep a running summary at the top as things land. Really appreciate how collaborative this has been on both sides.

Thanks Cindy. On the renewal timeline — we've mapped our side to land clean paperwork by June 18 so everything is ready well ahead of your internal review cycle. If anything on your end shifts that date, just flag it and we'll adjust.

On the enterprise onboarding point you raised: we've pulled together a proposed onboarding plan that shortens time-to-value for your new enterprise customers. Happy to walk the team through it — the goal is to take the manual steps out of the first 30 days so your support volume drops.

Adding the self-serve reporting item to the list — you'd asked about customers pulling their own QBR data. Good news: that's live in the current release. I'll share a short guide so your team can stop doing that reporting by hand.

And on reliability — I know uptime is a priority for you. We can share our current SLA and last-12-months uptime numbers in Thursday's review so you have the full picture. Happy to put that in writing as part of the agreement.

Summary of open items so far:
• Renewal paperwork ready by ~June 18
• Enterprise onboarding plan to review
• Self-serve QBR reporting — guide to follow
• Reliability/SLA numbers to share Thursday
Let me know if I've missed anything.
That covers it from our side. Thanks everyone — I'll get the summary and the reporting guide posted here before Thursday so we can keep the review focused. 🙌
